messages:
Priya: Noticing a backlog of inbound leads not getting owned. HubSpot shows 'waiting_for_enrichment' then SF never gets owner. Saw it for partner leads and small accounts. Any ideas?
Ethan: I saw a few earlier where the HubSpot->SF sync queue lagged and assignment rules in SF rejected the owner because the user lookup returned null.
Clara: That matches a handful of support tickets where users were deleted from SF but still in the HubSpot pool. Round-robin kept trying to assign to a missing user and bubbled to no-owner.
Priya: Sigh. That would also explain why SLA % slipped yesterday during the spike. Can we put a safety net in place immediately?
Sam: Short-term fix: add a workflow step in HubSpot to validate chosen owner exists and is active before finalizing assignment. If validation fails, send the contact to "inbound-handoff-hold" and notify #sales-ops.
Rory: We should also set an ownership_assigned_ts when it's put in hold so SLA timers start. Right now the timer only starts on successful owner assignment.
Ethan: Agree. Also propose we modify the round-robin algorithm to filter out SF users with status != 'Active' or with license_type = 'read-only'. That'll cut down on bad targets.
Clara: I'll run a script to reconcile user lists between HubSpot and SF and remove stale user IDs from HubSpot owner pools. ETA 2 hours.
Priya: For transparency, let's add a small playbook for Sales: when a contact lands in inbound-handoff-hold, Sales ops triages within 1 business hour, either assign to a live SDR or mark as partner-not-applicable.
Sam: HubSpot workflow (proposed):
```
Enroll contact -> enrichment step
If owner_candidate exists AND owner_candidate.status == 'Active' -> Assign owner and set ownership_assigned_ts = {{timestamp}}
Else -> Assign owner = inbound-handoff-hold; set ownership_assigned_ts = {{timestamp}}; POST slack webhook to #sales-ops
```
Rory: Round-robin pseudocode to update:
```
candidates = SELECT id FROM sdrs WHERE active=true AND license!='read-only' AND last_login > now() - interval '14 days'
if len(candidates)==0: return fallback_pool_id
return least_assigned(candidates)
```
Ethan: Also a mid-term change: change sync to surface failed assignments to the ops queue with reason codes (user_not_found, validation_failed, enrichment_pending). That will make triage faster.
Clara: I'll create a short reconciliation report that runs daily and surfaces contacts in SF with owner null but ownership_assigned_ts not set.
Priya: Tasks: Clara -> run reconciliation + daily report; Sam -> implement HubSpot validation workflow and webhook; Rory -> update round-robin filter; Ethan -> add failure reason codes to sync logs and create alert; Priya -> draft the sales playbook and SLA language.
hubspot-bot: Workflow change staged by Sam at 2026-04-02T09:12:00Z (staging wflow-212).
Sam: Deployed validation step to staging, webhook tested to #sales-ops (test message delivered).
Clara: Reconciliation script fetched ~18 stale user IDs; removing from pools now.
Ethan: Sync enhancement merged to main. We now log assignment failures with reason code and contact id. Setting alert for >5 failed assignments/hour.
Rory: Round-robin patch pushed to prod; now respects last_login and license filters.
Priya: Quick check after changes: new leads either assigned instantly or go to inbound-handoff-hold and we get an ops ping. SLA timer starts. Early numbers look good.
Sam: Will keep monitoring for 48h and then remove staging flag.
Priya: Thanks team. I'll finalize the playbook and post it to the ops docs. Closing thread once the 48h watch is complete. :rocket:
